def transform(grid):
    """Complete 180-degree rotational symmetry of the marked figure; additions are color 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for r in grid for x in r))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        rr, cc = r0 + r1 - r, c0 + c1 - c
        if grid[rr][cc] == bg:
            out[rr][cc] = 2
    return out
PY
